name: stale_aggregate
description: In the POST /api/orders/:o_orderkey/lineitems/:l_linenumber/ship endpoint, the o_latest_shipdate in orders is updated when a line item is shipped. However, if a line item's l_shipdate is modified or deleted through other write endpoints (not present in this code but possible via direct DB access or future endpoints), or if the MAX(l_shipdate) calculation logic changes, the cached o_latest_shipdate could become stale. More critically, the GET /api/orders/:o_orderkey endpoint reads o_latest_shipdate directly from orders without recalculating it from lineitem rows, serving the potentially stale cached value.
